preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the size of arrays A and B, N, is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**14 <= int(num) <= 10**14 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::3] for num in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each element in array A is between -10^14 and 10^14 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**14 <= int(num) <= 10**14 for line in stdin.splitlines()[3::3] for num in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each element in array B is between -10^14 and 10^14 inclusive.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == -1 or return_value[i] >= 0 for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 (impossible to convert) or a non-negative integer (minimum number of operations).

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == -1 or (all(A[i][j] + prefix_ops[i][j] + suffix_ops[i][j] == B[i][j] for j in range(N[i])) and prefix_ops[i][j] >= 0 and suffix_ops[i][j] >= 0 for i in range(T) for j in range(N[i]))
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, it is possible to convert A to B using the minimum number of prefix and suffix operations such that each element in A plus the corresponding prefix and suffix operations equals the corresponding element in B.
